57 void increment(OpType op, dim3 nodeCoords = {0, 0, 0})
58 {
59 switch (op)
60 {
61 case OpType::ParentReuse:
62 parentReuse++;
63 break;
64 case OpType::NeighborX:
65 if ((nodeCoords.x & 1) == 0)
66 neighborXNeg++;
67 else
68 neighborXPos++;
69 break;
70 case OpType::NeighborY:
71 if ((nodeCoords.y & 1) == 0)
72 neighborYNeg++;
73 else
74 neighborYPos++;
75 break;
76 case OpType::NeighborZ:
77 if ((nodeCoords.z & 1) == 0)
78 neighborZNeg++;
79 else
80 neighborZPos++;
81 break;
82 case OpType::PaletteAdvance:
83 paletteAdvance++;
84 break;
85 case OpType::PaletteBack0:
86 paletteBack0++;
87 break;
88 case OpType::PaletteBackD:
89 paletteBackD++;
90 break;
91 }
92 }

188 template <size_t b>
189 OpEntry bestOperation(
190 const Brick<b> &brick,
191 const Node &node,
192 const Node &parent,
193 size_t levelSize,
194 dim3 nodeCoords,
195 CompressedBrick &compressedBrick,
196 size_t levelIndex) // Add level index parameter
197 {
198 auto L = node.label;
199
200 // Parent reuse
201 // ------------------------------
202 if (parent.label == L)
203 return OpEntry{OpType::ParentReuse};
204 // ------------------------------
205 //
206 // Neighbor reuse (Rx, Ry, Rz)
207 // ------------------------------
208 auto currentMorton = Utils::morton3D(nodeCoords.x, nodeCoords.y, nodeCoords.z);
209
210 auto tryNeighbor = [&](dim3 nodeCoords, OpType opType) -> std::optional<OpType>
211 {
212 // ---------------------------------------
213 // Local position in the 2×2×2 sibling block
214 int lx = nodeCoords.x & 1;
215 int ly = nodeCoords.y & 1;
216 int lz = nodeCoords.z & 1;
217
218 int nx = nodeCoords.x;
219 int ny = nodeCoords.y;
220 int nz = nodeCoords.z;
221
222 // ---------------------------------------
223 // Move outside the 2×2×2 block depending on opType
224 switch (opType)
225 {
226 case OpType::NeighborX:
227 // neighbor must be OUTSIDE sibling block along X
228 nx = (lx == 0) ? nodeCoords.x - 1 : nodeCoords.x + 1;
229 break;
230
231 case OpType::NeighborY:
232 // neighbor must be OUTSIDE sibling block along Y
233 ny = (ly == 0) ? nodeCoords.y - 1 : nodeCoords.y + 1;
234 break;
235
236 case OpType::NeighborZ:
237 // neighbor must be OUTSIDE sibling block along Z
238 nz = (lz == 0) ? nodeCoords.z - 1 : nodeCoords.z + 1;
239 break;
240 }
241
242 // ---------------------------------------
243 // Bounds check
244 if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nz < 0 ||
245 nx >= levelSize || ny >= levelSize || nz >= levelSize)
246 return std::nullopt;
247
248 // ---------------------------------------
249 // Get neighbor
250 uint32_t neighborMorton = Utils::morton3D(nx, ny, nz);
251 const Node *neighbor = &brick.coarser(levelIndex)[neighborMorton];
252 if (!neighbor)
253 return std::nullopt;
254
255 // ---------------------------------------
256 if (neighborMorton < currentMorton)
257 {
258 // EARLIER in morton order -> allow reuse
259 return (neighbor->label == L) ? std::optional(opType)
260 : std::nullopt;
261 }
262
263 // ---------------------------------------
264 // fallback to parent
265 if (levelIndex > 0) // must NOT be in the FIRST level
266 {
267 uint32_t parentMorton = Utils::morton3D(nx >> 1, ny >> 1, nz >> 1);
268 const Node &parent = brick.coarser(levelIndex - 1)[parentMorton];
269
270 if (parent.label == L)
271 return opType;
272 }
273
274 return std::nullopt;
275 };
276
277 if (auto op = tryNeighbor(nodeCoords, OpType::NeighborX))
278 return OpEntry{*op};
279 if (auto op = tryNeighbor(nodeCoords, OpType::NeighborY))
280 return OpEntry{*op};
281 if (auto op = tryNeighbor(nodeCoords, OpType::NeighborZ))
282 return OpEntry{*op};
283 // ------------------------------
284
285 // Palette Lookup
286 // ---------------------------------------------
287 // Look for L in the palette (search from most recent backwards)
288 auto it = std::find(compressedBrick.palette.rbegin(), compressedBrick.palette.rend(), L);
289
290 if (it != compressedBrick.palette.rend())
291 {
292 // Convert reverse iterator to forward distance from end
293 size_t idx = compressedBrick.palette.size() - 1 - std::distance(compressedBrick.palette.rbegin(), it);
294 size_t last = compressedBrick.palette.size() - 1;
295
296 // ---- P0: last used palette entry ----
297 if (idx == last)
298 return {OpType::PaletteBack0}; // P0 in the paper
299
300 // ---- Pδ: back-reference up to 16 entries ----
301 // idx == last-1 -> δ = 0
302 // idx == last-2 -> δ = 1
303 // ...
304 size_t dist = last - idx - 1;
305
306 if (dist <= 15)
307 return {OpType::PaletteBackD, static_cast<uint8_t>(dist)};
308
309 // Label exists in palette but is too far back (> 16 entries)
310 // Re-add it to bring it to the front (palette advance with existing label)
311 // Note: This creates a duplicate in the palette, but allows recent access
312 return {OpType::PaletteAdvance};
313 }
314
315 // Palette advance (new label not in palette)
316 // ------------------------------
317 return {OpType::PaletteAdvance};
318 }

348 template <size_t b>
349 CompressedBrick encodeBrick(const Brick<b> &brick,
350 std::function<void(const CompressedBrick &)> updateFunc = nullptr)
351 {
352 CompressedBrick compressedBrick;
353 compressedBrick.palette.clear(); // Line 2: initialize empty palette
354
355 constexpr size_t levels = Brick<b>::Levels;
356
357 std::vector<OpEntry> operations; // store sequence of operations (op, stop)
358
359 // entry for the root node first
360 const Node &root = brick.coarser(0)[0]; // single root node
361 compressedBrick.palette.push_back(root.label); // Add root label to palette
362
363 // Encode an operation for the root node
364 OpEntry rootEntry;
365 rootEntry.op = OpType::PaletteAdvance; // root is always in palette
366 rootEntry.stopBit = root.constantChildren ? 0x01 : 0x00;
367 operations.push_back(rootEntry);
368 // globalOperationStats.increment(rootEntry.op); // Track root operation
369
370 // --- Loop over levels from coarsest (0) to the second-to-finest (N-1) ---
371 // Corresponds to pseudocode line 3: "for l ∈ [N .. 1]"
372 for (size_t l = 0; l < levels - 1; ++l)
373 {
374 const auto &levelNodes = brick.coarser(l); // current level nodes
375 const size_t nodesInLevel = levelNodes.size();
376 const size_t childLevelSize = b >> (levels - 2 - l); // size in one dimension
377
378 // Traverse nodes in Morton/Z-order
379 // Pseudocode line 4: "for all nodes on level l (spacing 2^l) in Z-order do"
380 for (size_t mortonIdx = 0; mortonIdx < nodesInLevel; ++mortonIdx)
381 {
382 const Node &parentNode = levelNodes[mortonIdx];
383
384 // Skip nodes with constant children (interior levels)
385 // Pseudocode line 6: "if pyramid[i].constantChildren then continue"
386 if (parentNode.constantChildren)
387 continue;
388
389 const auto &childrenLevel = brick.coarser(l + 1); // next finer level
390
391 // Decode Morton index to get 3D coordinates of the parent
392 dim3 parentIdx = Utils::decodeMorton3D(mortonIdx);
393
394 // --- Loop over 8 child nodes in Z-order ---
395 // Pseudocode lines 8-9: "for all child nodes (spacing 2^(l-1)) in Z-order do"
396 for (uint32_t childIdxLocal = 0; childIdxLocal < 8; ++childIdxLocal)
397 {
398 // Decode child local offsets in 3D (bitmask)
399 uint32_t dx = childIdxLocal & 1; // bit 0 → x offset
400 uint32_t dy = (childIdxLocal >> 1) & 1; // bit 1 → y offset
401 uint32_t dz = (childIdxLocal >> 2) & 1; // bit 2 → z offset
402
403 // Compute 3D coordinates of child in the grid
404 // Pseudocode line 9: "j ← index of current child node"
405 uint32_t childX = parentIdx.x * 2 + dx;
406 uint32_t childY = parentIdx.y * 2 + dy;
407 uint32_t childZ = parentIdx.z * 2 + dz;
408
409 // Convert child coordinates to Morton index to access array
410 size_t mortonChildIdx = Utils::morton3D(childX, childY, childZ);
411 const Node &childNode = childrenLevel[mortonChildIdx];
412
413 LabelType L = childNode.label; // Pseudocode line 10: "L ← pyramid[j].label"
414 bool stop = childNode.constantChildren; // Pseudocode line 11: "stop ← pyramid[j].constantChildren"
415
416 // Determine the best operation for this child
417 // Pseudocode line 12: "op ← bestOperation(parent, pyramid, palette, L)"
418 dim3 childCoords{(int)childX, (int)childY, (int)childZ};
419 OpEntry entry = bestOperation(brick, childNode, parentNode, childLevelSize, childCoords, compressedBrick, l + 1);
420
421 // Update palette if operation requires
422 // Pseudocode line 13: "if op = Pa then palette.push(L)"
423 if (entry.op == OpType::PaletteAdvance)
424 compressedBrick.palette.push_back(L);
425
426 // Set stopBit and leaf status
427 // Pseudocode line 15: "output (op, stop)"
428 entry.stopBit = stop ? 0x01 : 0x00;
429
430 operations.push_back(entry); // append operation to stream
431 // globalOperationStats.increment(entry.op, childCoords); // Track operation statistic with coordinates
432 }
433 }
434 }
435
436 // Pack the operations to nibbles (4-bit) for output
437 auto [bytes, nibbleCount] = packOperationsToNibbles(operations);
438 compressedBrick.encodedData = std::move(bytes);
439 compressedBrick.ID = brick.ID;
440 compressedBrick.nSymbols = static_cast<uint32_t>(nibbleCount);
441
442 // Optional callback to update external stream
443 if (updateFunc)
444 updateFunc(compressedBrick);
445
446 return compressedBrick;
447 }

452 template <typename T>
453 inline void ransFlush(T &state, std::vector<uint8_t> &out)
454 {
455 // Determine how many bytes we need to fully represent the state
456 size_t byteCount = sizeof(T);
457
458 // Push out least-significant byte first (little-endian)
459 for (size_t i = 0; i < byteCount; ++i)
460 {
461 out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(state & 0xFF));
462 state >>= 8;
463 }
464 }

466 template <size_t b>
467 CompressedDataset compressDataset(std::vector<Brick<b>> &bricks)
468 {
469 // Encode to nibbles
470 std::vector<CompressedBrick> compressedBricks;
471 compressedBricks.reserve(bricks.size());
472
473 for (size_t i = 0; i < bricks.size(); ++i)
474 {
475 auto &brick = bricks[i];
476
477 // Build pyramid
478 brick.build();
479
480 // Encode operations
481 CompressedBrick compressedBrick = encodeBrick(brick,
482 (i % 512 == 0) ? updateFrequencyTables : nullptr);
483 compressedBricks.push_back(compressedBrick);
484 }
485
486 // build RANS models
487 RansModel interiorModel = buildRansModel(interiorFreqTable);
488 // RansModel leafModel = buildRansModel(leafFreqTable);
489
490 // rANS compress each brick
491 for (auto &brick : compressedBricks)
492 {
493 // Flatten the nibble stream with isLeaf/interior info
494 struct SymbolEntry
495 {
496 uint8_t nibble;
497 };
498 std::vector<SymbolEntry> symbols;
499
500 size_t nibIndex = 0;
501 for (uint8_t byte : brick.encodedData)
502 {
503 uint8_t hi = byte >> 4;
504 uint8_t lo = byte & 0x0F;
505
506 // High nibble
507 symbols.push_back({hi});
508
509 // Low nibble
510 symbols.push_back({lo});
511 }
512
513 // Encode symbols backwards
514 uint32_t state = RANS_INIT;
515 std::vector<uint8_t> compressedStream;
516 compressedStream.reserve(brick.encodedData.size()); // rough reserve
517
518 for (const auto &entry : std::views::reverse(symbols))
519 ransEncodeSymbol(state, compressedStream, entry.nibble, interiorModel);
520
521 // Final flush
522 ransFlush(state, compressedStream);
523
524 // The output is now forward-order byte stream for decoder
525 brick.encodedData = std::move(compressedStream);
526 }
527
528 return CompressedDataset{
529 .model = interiorModel,
530 .bricks = std::move(compressedBricks)};
531 }
